en.title: Why the PLA's Z-10 attack helicopter is taking a bigger role at sea
en.summary: China's Z-10 attack helicopter, originally designed for ground operations, is undergoing increased training for maritime operations from ships. This development could potentially enhance Beijing's military capabilities for amphibious operations.

stories.title: Chinese ‘Coffee Grandma’ learns brewing to save son’s cafe, inspires female independence

en.title: Chinese 'Coffee Grandma' learns brewing to save son's cafe, inspires female independence
en.summary: An 86-year-old Chinese woman took over and revitalized her son's struggling coffee shop in Qingdao in 2015 despite having no prior coffee experience. She has since become a social media sensation, becoming a symbol of female entrepreneurship and independence.
